answer: A single identity may take at most 13% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. The jetty cap is applied at the ember settlement and visible in the juniper breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. Because of that, capturing the pool needs several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
